'''Kiaraway''', or '''Kiara''' for short (Japanese: '''キャラウエー''' ''Caraway'') is a Pokémon Trainer from the manga series [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Character==
Kiaraway specializes in collecting {{type|Fire}} Pokémon. He is a cocky, arrogant, goofy boy who has a big crush on [[Coconut]].

==History==
Kiaraway is first mentioned in ''[[PPP50|Vulpix and Cyndaquil]]'' as {{p|Vulpix}} and {{p|Cyndaquil}}'s Trainer, or "Big Bro", shown in silhouette only. He is fully introduced later in ''[[PPP63|Coconut's Love Waltz (Part 1)]]'', where he comes to meet Coconut on the recommendation of Vulpix and Cyndaquil and immediately gets a huge crush on Coconut, stealing her first kiss.

Despite Coconut's resistance, he continues to pursue her until the end of the manga. In the "Thank You Page", where author [[Yumi Tsukirino]] describes what happens to each character after the end of the story, she states that Kiaraway and Coconut will begin dating within a few years.
